categories. Finite-index subgroup descriptions and computable Fuchsian domains
provide representation and reduction ingredients (P31-S01--P31-S06). Ambient,
arithmetic, and hyperbolic conjugacy methods provide decision ingredients that
still require an exact \texttt{Gamma\_0(11)} specialization
(P31-S07--P31-S20). The proof-carrying-code record \citep{P31-S23} and
tamper-evident-logging record \citep{P31-S24} are retained as metadata-identified
method neighbors only; no substantive method-pattern transfer is drawn from
them without an exact retained original passage. Aggregate class-counting
neighbors remain post-closure controls (P31-S21--P31-S22). The resolved-domain
canonicalizer specification, total disposition, derived regression audit, and
distinct \texttt{G/I/C} projections are prospective project design choices.
They are not a new conjugacy theorem, an implemented solver, a priority claim,
or an exhaustive novelty claim.
